wiki.title: Gloam Overlord
wiki.text:
The Gloam Overlord is an NPC featured as the antagonist of Free Realms. He has come to Sacred Grove to cause danger and harm to its people. The player must help Darkthorne defeat him and defend the Cobblestone Village from his evil forces. The Gloam Overlord and his will lieutenants try to corrupt the various regions of Free Realms, when a new evil appears, the player must defeat them.

History
Not much is known about him. But it is known that he is the leader of the Gloam and caused the battle in Shrouded Glade, and now he is causing harm to the Cobblestone Village.

Cobblestone Village
Now that the Gloam Overlord had come to the Cobblestone Village, he sent his forces to wreak havoc on its citizens. And Darkthorne has sent the player there to help and defeat the Gloam in the village. But soon enough, he will cause more harm, and its up to the player to save Sacred Grove.
